deadline.evidence: Rules section 1 and all three page headers agree.

mandatory_delivery.code: Public repository; open-source license; complete source/assets and setup/run instructions.
mandatory_delivery.demo: Working demo, hosted app or test-build URL; judge access free and unrestricted through judging. Physical AI exception does not apply to Coding.
mandatory_delivery.video: Publicly visible YouTube URL; keep below 180 seconds; show functioning software and required platform/model integration.
mandatory_delivery.description: Features, selected track, integration feedback and significant competition-period changes to pre-existing work.
mandatory_delivery.evidence: Rules section 4, including Testing; overview What to Submit.

technical.all_projects: Nebius Token Factory or AI Cloud plus an NVIDIA open-source model. Runtime inference API usage or specified Nebius compute establishes platform use.
technical.coding_track: Coding agents/developer tools that write, execute and test code in Token Factory.
technical.prior_work: Permitted with substantial updates after the submission period began; explain those changes.

interpretation_limits: No explicit requirement for a main-branch merge, CI workflow, GitHub Release or a particular hosting vendor was found.
A saved-run record alone does not guarantee eligibility: the supplied working project must satisfy the actual technical requirements.
Official publication requirements do not authorize changing the user's private repository or submitting on their behalf.
